body: This is wrong/misleading. Is there a way to opt out of these values while still using int validation?
admission_reason: line inside a changed hunk at the checkpoint
matchable_reason: open-api/immich-openapi-specs.json:16607 at the checkpoint is `"maximum": 9007199254740991,` (with `"minimum": -9007199254740991,` on 16608) — the misleading safe-integer bounds the comment objects to were introduced by this very diff when .min(1).max(5) was replaced by .refine() in server/src/dtos/asset.dto.ts:19-21, and appear twice in the spec (also at 26430).
thread_group_defect: Dropping .min(1)/.max(5) in favor of a .refine() makes the generated OpenAPI schema advertise maximum/minimum of +/-9007199254740991 for `rating`, so the published contract no longer states the real allowed range.
